scope: Plain-language presentation. Results, priorities, source identities, and release decision stay unchanged.

attention.title: Signing out does not fully end the session
attention.what_happened: The access credential had already expired when sign-out reported success. The same valid refresh credential then obtained new access.
attention.reason: The sign-out code did not record that the session had ended. It recorded zero entries to prevent further renewal.
attention.user_impact: Someone already holding a copied refresh credential could regain access after sign-out. No real account compromise was demonstrated.
attention.missing_check: Show that sign-out prevents further renewal, or show that this release cannot reach the failing code.
attention.priority_reason: P1 remains because the test proves a broken sign-out security boundary. This is the release blocker.
attention.next_action: Correct the sign-out code or prove it cannot affect this release. Then repeat the renewal attempt after sign-out.
attention.limits: The test ran real server authentication code with stand-in storage and other services. It did not test a production deployment.

attention.title: An old timeout window can block a new session
attention.what_happened: A new login succeeded before an earlier sign-out action finished. The old timeout window stayed open with unusable buttons.
attention.reason: The code protected the new login from the old sign-out action. It did not close the old timeout window.
attention.user_impact: The browser test left a valid new session behind a window that could not recover the workspace.
attention.missing_check: Confirm whether a supported application can start a new login during this short sign-out delay.
attention.priority_reason: P2 remains because the browser test showed blocked recovery. Whether a deployed application can trigger it remains unknown.
attention.next_action: Check supported login flows. If this timing is possible, correct the timeout window and repeat the browser test.
attention.limits: The browser test used an earlier candidate. The relevant logic is unchanged, but the current candidate was not retested.

attention.title: A delayed error can clear a renewed session
attention.what_happened: An earlier request returned an expired-session error after renewal succeeded. The app then removed the newly renewed access and refresh credentials.
attention.reason: The app treated the delayed error as a failure of the renewed session. It displayed a sign-in-again error.
attention.user_impact: Users could be asked to sign in again after successful renewal. An actual forced logout was not observed.
attention.missing_check: Confirm that a supported server can return this error at this time. Then check the complete browser journey.
attention.priority_reason: P2 remains because the test removed valid renewed credentials. Whether real services produce this sequence remains unknown.
attention.next_action: Repeat the sequence with a supported server and application. Check that an old error cannot erase a valid renewed session.
attention.limits: The test ran the app's session code with controlled responses and a test clock. It used no live business service.
attention.owner: Application and authentication owners not assigned.

criteria.title: Renew the session during mouse activity
criteria.what_happened: Continuous mouse movement produced no successful renewal during the 15-second test.
criteria.reason: Each movement restarted a five-second waiting period. The renewal call never started while movement continued.
criteria.user_impact: This activity did not renew the session during the test. Later sign-out and lost work were not observed.
criteria.missing_check: The required renewal did not happen. The test did not continue to measure later expiry or work loss.
criteria.next_action: Keep this P4 backlog item. Correct and retest the agreed mouse-activity behavior when scheduled.

criteria.reason: The Home page has no keyboard event handler that starts session renewal.
criteria.user_impact: Typing did not renew the session during the test. Later sign-out and lost work were not observed.
criteria.missing_check: The required renewal did not happen. The test did not continue to measure later expiry or work loss.
criteria.next_action: Keep this P4 backlog item. Correct and retest the agreed keyboard-activity behavior when scheduled.

criteria.title: Stay signed in through four simulated hours
criteria.what_happened: The browser completed four simulated hours. Renewal continued, and no local sign-in window appeared.
criteria.reason: The test used a replacement sign-in service. It did not observe the real sign-in provider or protected business service.
criteria.user_impact: The local test kept working. Whether users can keep using real services for the same period remains unverified.
criteria.missing_check: Check the real sign-in provider for new login prompts. Confirm that the real protected service accepts the renewed session.
criteria.next_action: Keep this P3 follow-up. Repeat the test with the real sign-in provider and protected service.

criteria.title: Keep the timeout window open while renewal is pending
criteria.what_happened: The timeout window stayed open while the renewal request was waiting for a response.
criteria.reason: The local test observed no early closure.
criteria.user_impact: The tested window behavior passed. Acceptance by real sign-in services remains a separate check.
criteria.missing_check: No failed check remains within this local window test.
criteria.next_action: Keep the passing result and repeat it after relevant changes.

criteria.title: Close the timeout window once after successful renewal
criteria.what_happened: Successful renewal closed the timeout window exactly once. The replacement service accepted the new access credential.
criteria.reason: The tested success response updated the local session and closed the window once.
criteria.user_impact: The local recovery behavior passed. This does not prove access to a real protected business service.
criteria.missing_check: No failed check remains within this local window test.
criteria.next_action: Keep the passing result and check real service access separately.

criteria.title: Allow another renewal attempt after failure
criteria.what_happened: Failed renewal left the timeout window open. The renewal button remained available for another attempt.
criteria.reason: The tested failure response did not close the window or disable retry.
criteria.user_impact: The local retry behavior passed. Acceptance by real sign-in services remains a separate check.
criteria.missing_check: No failed check remains within this local window test.
criteria.next_action: Keep the passing result and repeat it after relevant changes.
